reason: When ESC follows incomplete UTF-8 (f0 9f), xterm drops the incomplete bytes and vte writes one U+FFFD cell. Does not happen in normal output

The U+FFFD from the entry above is on the oxtty screen, so the snapshot carries it too. text/incomplete-utf8 takes the snapshot before the ESC, so the incomplete bytes ride at the end of the payload as is and it is equal in B
The oxtty cell has no overline bit (SGR 53 ignored). wmux has also refused ANSI snapshots when it sees SGR 53
After SGR 59 xterm reports the underline color as RGB 0xFFFFFF (judged to be an xterm 6.1 beta bug). oxtty reports the default
oxtty ignores ?9 (X10 mouse). It is an input reporting mode, not screen state
For a combining character or ZWJ with no preceding character to attach to, xterm puts it in a width-0 cell and moves the cursor. oxtty attaches it to a blank cell
xterm treats LF as CR+LF under LNM (CSI 20 h); oxtty ignores LNM

A 21→8 column resize makes a wide character start in the last column. Reprinting it would wrap, so the snapshot is refused. The wmux bench refused this case for the same reason, and on refusal wmux restores without a snapshot
DECSTBM margins narrower than the screen are not carried in the snapshot and are refused (same scope as the wmux serializer). When to carry them awaits an owner decision

DL (CSI M) on the first line of the primary screen makes Alacritty push the deleted line into scrollback (Grid::scroll_up from line 0 rotates into history) while xterm drops it. The alternate screen has no scrollback so it is equal, and DL on the first line of the primary screen is rare
